new.title: One row-by-row scan approximates every indexed cyclic solution count to a prescribed relative precision
new.statement:
∀ (n w b : Nat), 0 < n → 0 < w →
  let D := 2^w
  let K := 2^b
  let S := min (2^(n*2^(w+1))) ((1+4*(n+1)^2*K)^(D*D))
  let Row := Nat → Bool
  let total := fun (rows : Nat → Row) =>
    ((List.range (2^n)).filter (fun word => (List.range n).all (fun site =>
      let pat := (List.range (w+1)).foldl (fun (acc bit : Nat) =>
        acc ||| ((word.testBit ((site+bit)%n)).toNat <<< bit)) 0
      rows site pat))).length
  ∃ (start : Fin S) (step : Nat → Fin S → Row → Fin S) (readout : Fin S → Nat),
    ∀ table : Nat → Row,
      let estimate := readout ((List.range n).foldl (fun state i => step i state (table i)) start)
      estimate ≤ total table ∧ K * total table ≤ (K+1)*estimate
new.unlocks: approximates the indexed cyclic count in one pass with bounded states at the requested precision
new.context: Start the natural endpoint matrix at the identity. After each row, round each updated count down. Put H=2(n+1)K. Keep x<H exactly. Otherwise choose the largest e with H·2^e≤x and keep floor(x/2^e)·2^e. The mantissa is below 2H, e≤n, and rounding retains at least (H-1)x/H. Nonnegative matrix multiplication preserves entrywise inequalities. After i rounds retain at least (1-i/H) of each exact count. The trace at n counts the indexed words by L-lib-377. Since (K+1)n≤H, its rounded trace has the required precision. Alternatively store the n raw rows and evaluate exactly.

Otherwise choose the largest e with H·2^e≤x and keep floor(x/2^e)·2^e. The mantissa is below 2H, e≤n, and rounding retains at least (H-1)x/H. Nonnegative matrix multiplication preserves entrywise inequalities. After i rounds retain at least (1-i/H) of each exact count. The trace at n counts the indexed words by L-lib-377. Since (K+1)n≤H, its rounded trace has the required precision. Alternatively store the n raw rows and evaluate exactly.

new.title: Binary rank gives the exact one-layer nonlinear gate count for fan-in-two circuits on a one-hot table
new.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  ∀ t : ℕ, A.rank ≤ 2*t ↔
    ∃ C, represents C ∧ depth (n+m) C ≤ 1 ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t
new.unlocks: determines the exact cost of all one-layer nonlinear selectors from binary anchored rank
new.context: Every affine wire on two one-hot banks is a row function plus a column function. Expanding a product gives two mixed outer products. The other terms vanish on taking four corners. Sum the rank bounds over the nonlinear gates feeding the output. Conversely factor the anchored matrix into r outer products. Pair ac and bd, where a,b depend on the row and c,d on the column. The gate (a+d)(b+c) gives both after local corrections ab and cd. Pad an odd pair with zero. Every local table is a free XOR lookup. Allow 2 to 4 hours.
new.sketch: Every affine wire on two one-hot banks is a row function plus a column function. Expanding a product gives two mixed outer products. The other terms vanish on taking four corners. Sum the rank bounds over the nonlinear gates feeding the output. Conversely factor the anchored matrix into r outer products. Pair ac and bd, where a,b depend on the row and c,d on the column. The gate (a+d)(b+c) gives both after local corrections ab and cd. Pad an odd pair with zero. Every local table is a free XOR lookup. Allow 2 to 4 hours.

new.title: Two binomial sums bound the binary rank of one-hot tables at fixed nonlinear depth in fan-in-two circuits
new.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∀ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C → depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 →
    A.rank ≤ budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d)
new.unlocks: bounds the anchored matrix rank for every finite nonlinear depth and gate count
new.context: Introduce one formal product bit per nonlinear gate. Each product operand is an affine raw tap plus earlier product bits. Substitution on the output cone gives a polynomial of degree at most 2^(d+1) in 2t taps, plus a raw affine term. Split each tap into its bank labels. Four-corner differences erase pure terms. With b=2^d every mixed monomial has row degree at most b or column degree at most b-1. Group by the chosen nonempty squarefree monomial on that bank, one rank-one matrix per group. Allow 3 to 6 hours.

With b=2^d every mixed monomial has row degree at most b or column degree at most b-1. Group by the chosen nonempty squarefree monomial on that bank, one rank-one matrix per group. Allow 3 to 6 hours.

changed.title: Affine restrictions of XOR-AND circuits in terms of their multiplicative complexity (known result rebuilt)
changed.statement:
∀ n : ℕ,
  let V := Fin n → ZMod 2
  let admissible := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C ∧
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates,
      (g.op = .and ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) ∨
      (g.op = .mod 2 ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∨
      (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1))
  let cost := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    C.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (g.op = .and) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let input := fun (x : V) => List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => decide (x i = 1))
  ∀ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (f : V → ZMod 2),
    admissible C → (∀ x : V, C.eval (input x) = decide (f x = 1)) →
    ∃ (U : Submodule (ZMod 2) V) (p a : V) (b : ZMod 2),
      n ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) U + cost C ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, f (p+x) = dotProduct a (p+x) + b
changed.unlocks: Gives the codimension step used in L-lib-506 and L-lib-507.
changed.context: Boyar and Find, elimination argument for Proposition 2. Restrict affinely through a nested circuit one AND at a time. Estimated proof time 2 to 4 hours.
changed.sketch: On paper. Start with the full cube and visit gates in order. Affine gates preserve affine wire functions. At an AND, if its first operand is constant then its product remains affine. Otherwise restrict its first affine operand to zero. This costs one dimension, preserves every earlier affine wire and makes the product constant. Extend the final affine output from the resulting flat.

changed.title: A finite Boolean zero set gives a degree bound for polynomial calculus consequence (known result rebuilt)
changed.statement:
∀ (n w : ℕ), let P := MvPolynomial (Fin n) (ZMod 2)
  let B := {q : P | ∃ i : Fin n, q = MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.X i}
  ∀ (G : Set P) (p : P), (∀ g ∈ G, MvPolynomial.totalDegree g ≤ w) →
    ((∀ a : Fin n → ZMod 2, (∀ g ∈ G, MvPolynomial.eval a g = 0) → MvPolynomial.eval a p = 0) ↔
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCDerivable (B ∪ G) (max p.totalDegree (n + w)) p)
changed.unlocks: Turns semantic membership in a Boolean zero-set ideal into an explicit polynomial calculus budget.
changed.context: Expand the multilinear representative in the point indicators of cube assignments. At every point where the target is one choose a violated generator. Its product with the point indicator has the indicator as its Boolean normal form and degree at most n+w. Derive the product from the generator, reduce, and sum. Return to the target using its own Boolean normal form. Evaluation at any common zero proves the converse.
changed.sketch: Expand the multilinear representative in the point indicators of cube assignments. At every point where the target is one choose a violated generator. Its product with the point indicator has the indicator as its Boolean normal form and degree at most n+w. Derive the product from the generator, reduce, and sum. Return to the target using its own Boolean normal form. Evaluation at any common zero proves the converse.

changed.title: The PPZ code for satisfying assignments at a fixed variable order is prefix-free (known result rebuilt)
changed.statement:
∀ n : Nat,
  let V := Fin n
  let Point := V → Bool
  let Clause := Finset (V × Bool)
  let sat := fun (formula : Finset Clause) (x : Point) =>
    ∀ c ∈ formula, ∃ lit ∈ c, x lit.1 = lit.2
  let Order := Equiv.Perm V
  ∀ F : Finset Clause,
    let forced := fun (s : Point) (order : Order) =>
      (Finset.univ : Finset V).filter (fun i =>
        ∃ c ∈ F, (i,s i) ∈ c ∧ ∀ e ∈ c, e = (i,s i) ∨
          ((order e.1).val < (order i).val ∧ s e.1 ≠ e.2))
    let code := fun (s : Point) (order : Order) =>
      (List.finRange n).filterMap (fun rank =>
        let v := order.symm rank
        if v ∈ forced s order then none else some (s v))
    ∀ (order : Order) (s z : Point), sat F s → sat F z →
      (code s order).length + (forced s order).card = n ∧
      ((∃ tail : List Bool, code s order ++ tail = code z order) → s = z)
changed.unlocks: Supplies the decoding and Kraft step for the weighted SAT coding bound.
changed.context: Decode in variable order, setting a unit literal without consuming a bit, and otherwise consuming the next bit. On the prefix of a model, two residual unit clauses cannot demand opposite values. The stated test for omission is determined by this prefix for every model extension. Comparable codes therefore reconstruct identical assignments by induction. Count the omitted and emitted positions.

Comparable codes therefore reconstruct identical assignments by induction. Count the omitted and emitted positions.

changed.title: Fano plane: a circuit of at most 27 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, C.size ≤ 27 ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ a b : ℕ, g.inputs = [a, b] ∧ a ≠ b ∧ a < 14 + j ∧ b < 14 + j) ∧ (∀ x : Fin 14 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u t : Fin 7, (u = t ∨ u = t + 1 ∨ u = t + 3) ∧ x (Fin.castAdd 7 u) = true ∧ x (Fin.natAdd 7 t) = true) ∧ ∃ p l : Fin 7, (p = l ∨ p = l + 1 ∨ p = l + 3) ∧ (∃ v : ℕ → Bool, (∀ my : Fin 7, v my.val = false ∧ v (7 + my.val) = decide (my = l)) ∧ (∀ (ky : ℕ) (hy : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (cy dy : ℕ), C.gates[ky]? = some hy → hy.inputs = [cy, dy] → (hy.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → v (14 + ky) = (((C.wires (List.ofFn (fun iy : Fin 14 => decide (iy = Fin.castAdd 7 p)))).getD cy false && v dy) || (v cy && (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun ey : Fin 14 => decide (ey = Fin.castAdd 7 p)))).getD dy false))) ∧ (hy.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → v (14 + ky) = (v cy || v dy))) ∧ v C.output = false) ∧ (∃ w : ℕ → Bool, (∀ mx : Fin 7, w mx.val = decide (mx = p) ∧ w (7 + mx.val) = false) ∧ (∀ (kx : ℕ) (hx : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (cx dx : ℕ), C.gates[kx]? = some hx → hx.inputs = [cx, dx] → (hx.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → w (14 + kx) = (((C.wires (List.ofFn (fun ix : Fin 14 => decide (ix = Fin.natAdd 7 l)))).getD cx false && w dx) || (w cx && (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun ex : Fin 14 => decide (ex = Fin.natAdd 7 l)))).getD dx false))) ∧ (hx.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → w (14 + kx) = (w cx || w dx))) ∧ w C.output = false)
